episode_id: Some setting in my config has been renamed upstream. Sort the config out. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-12-config_renamed-212

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
set -eu
cd "{work_dir}"
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | sed '/^$/d' > "$tmp/tracked"
{ git ls-files --others -z; git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z; } | tr '\0' '\n' | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u > "$tmp/untracked"
: > "$tmp/pairs"
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  b=$(basename "$f" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
  case "$b" in
    *rename*) ;;
    *) if grep -qi 'renamed' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then :; else continue; fi ;;
  esac
  grep -E '^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*[[:space:]]*$' "$f" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/[[:space:]]//g' | awk -F= '$1 != "" && $2 != "" && $1 != $2 { print $1 "\t" $2 }' >> "$tmp/pairs"
done < "$tmp/tracked"
sort -u -o "$tmp/pairs" "$tmp/pairs"
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r o n; do
    if [ -n "$o" ] && grep -qE "^[[:space:]]*$o[[:space:]]*=" "$f"; then
      sed -i -E "s/^([[:space:]]*)$o([[:space:]]*=)/\1$n\2/" "$f"
    fi
  done < "$tmp/pairs"
done < "$tmp/untracked"
refused_program.intent: A setting has been renamed upstream according to a rename map committed in the repository. Rewrite the stale old key to its new name inside the user's own untracked/ignored config override file, leaving every tracked file and the git index untouched so the override file stays out of git.
